hero.subtitle: A software developer who
hero.headline: Builds digital solutions
hero.desc1: With a foundation in .NET and over six years in IT support, I create secure and scalable digital solutions that solve real-world problems with both precision and creativity.
hero.desc2: I have one year of professional experience as a full-stack developer, working on everything from backend architecture to modern and intuitive frontend experiences. Today, I am a co-founder of a startup AB focused on building meaningful digital products.
hero.desc3: I'm currently advancing my skills in IT security development, combining software engineering with a security-focused mindset to build technology that is not only powerful but also resilient.

exp1.title: Fullstack Developer
exp1.description: Built a new business system from scratch with .NET Core Web API, TypeScript, and Tailwind.
exp1.details:
During my time at the company, I worked across the entire stack, from databases and relational handling to backend in .NET Core Web API and frontend in TypeScript.
I was responsible for database structure and necessary changes.
On the frontend side, I built a responsive interface with TypeScript and Tailwind, customizing UI components.
In the backend, I implemented business logic and efficient data handling.
The system simplified the administration of company information, employees, and customer relations, improving workflows and internal communication.

exp2.title: IT Support Technician
exp2.description: Solved network, hardware, and software issues for employees.
exp2.details:
Responsible for solving technical problems for employees by providing fast and efficient support both onsite and via remote assistance.
Diagnosed and resolved network, hardware, and software issues.
Created and updated documentation for technical systems and procedures.
This position was held alongside my studies.

exp3.title: Higher Vocational Education
exp3.description: Studies in .NET, C#, ASP.NET, React, SQL, and CMS implementation.
exp3.details:
Studies included .NET web development with HTML, CSS, JavaScript for frontend, and C# plus ASP.NET for backend.
Data storage with SQL and CMS implementation.
The education provided a broad understanding of fullstack development, modern frameworks, and architectural principles.

exp4.title: Sales Associate
exp4.description: Helped customers with technical problems and product selection.
exp4.details:
As a sales associate, I assisted customers with product selection and provided technical advice.
I used my technical knowledge to solve problems and give recommendations, requiring the ability to explain complex information in a simple way.

skills.title: My core skills and the ecosystem I build with
skills.subtitle:
Core stack: C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, databases and modern tooling.
Everything around it is the ecosystem I use to build fullstack solutions.

Inadra.title: Inadra Business System
Inadra.desc: Fullstack development of a new internal business system in .NET and TypeScript.
Inadra.details: During my time as a full-stack developer at Inadra AB, I worked across the entire stack, from database modeling and relationships to backend in .NET Core Web API and frontend in TypeScript. I developed a new business system replacing an older internal system, handling database design, business logic, and UI in Tailwind. The solution improved administration of company information, staff, and customer relations.

calendra.title: Calendra Business System
calendra.desc: A complete business platform for bookings, staff, economy and administration.
calendra.details: Calendra is a modern business platform combining everything a company needs: bookings, staff management, accounting, administration and more. I worked on architecture, UX, the design system and the technical foundation for a scalable modular system.

solsidan.title: Solsidan Booking Platform
solsidan.desc: End-to-end booking system for restaurants with table layout, rules and automation.
solsidan.details: Solsidan is a fullstack booking platform with table layout, rule-based seating and an admin interface. I built the frontend in React/TypeScript and connected to a .NET API. It manages opening hours, sittings, guest limits and tools for staff to manage reservations.

skonhetscenter.title: Beauty Nails Website
skonhetscenter.desc: A modern and clean website for a beauty salon.
skonhetscenter.details: A static website developed for a beauty salon with focus on visuals, structure and user experience. Built in React/Vite with Tailwind and Shadcn UI.

Phonomenal.title: Vietnamese Restaurant Website
Phonomenal.desc: Modern restaurant website with an admin system for updating services and prices.
Phonomenal.meta: React • TypeScript • Tailwind • Custom Admin Panel
Phonomenal.details: A custom website built for a Vietnamese restaurant with a strong focus on menu presentation and service information. Includes a logged-in admin interface for updating content.

security-lab.title: Security Lab Environment
security-lab.desc: Hyper-V lab with pfSense, Suricata, Wazuh, Nessus and segmented network design.
security-lab.meta: Network security • Blue team • Lab design
security-lab.details: A personal security lab environment using pfSense firewall, Suricata IDS/IPS, Wazuh SIEM and Nessus scanning. Networks are segmented into LAN, DMZ, Guest and Management. Used for both blue team and red team practice.

vena-vardshus.title: Vena Värdshus Website
vena-vardshus.desc: A modern and mobile-friendly website for a countryside inn.
vena-vardshus.details: A complete website for Vena Värdshus highlighting menus, opening hours and contact details with a clean responsive layout.

aurora-restaurant.title: Aurora Restaurant Website
aurora-restaurant.desc: A visually strong website focused on menu, ambiance and brand identity.
aurora-restaurant.details: Aurora is a modern restaurant website emphasizing atmosphere and identity. I designed the UI/UX, layout, image selection and responsive design.

salon-template.title: Hair & Beauty Salon Template
salon-template.desc: A complete template for beauty salons that can be sold and customized.
salon-template.details: A reusable template designed for salons with sections for services, pricing, gallery and contact. Optimized for fast customization.

futureflow-recon.title: FutureFlow Internal Recon
futureflow-recon.desc: Network reconnaissance focusing on host discovery, services and attack surfaces.
futureflow-recon.details: A security project performing internal reconnaissance with Nmap to identify hosts, ports and risks. The findings were compiled into a full attack-surface analysis.

about.title: About me
about.p1: My name is Oskar Lindqvist and I am a solution oriented .NET developer with full-stack experience and a degree in .NET web development. I work across the entire stack from database design and backend architecture to modern and intuitive frontend solutions.
about.p2: I am methodical, fast and quality-driven. In my daily work, I use advanced AI tools such as ChatGPT to accelerate development, optimize solutions, and ensure high quality.
about.p3: In addition to development, I have over six years of IT experience including IT support in Bangkok which has given me broad technical knowledge and strong problem solving skills.
about.p4: I am looking for a workplace where development, quality, and teamwork are essential. I am confident that I can contribute positively to your team.
